Package com.bupt.ta.ai

Class LmClientFactory

java.lang.Object
com.bupt.ta.ai.LmClientFactory
public final class LmClientFactory extends Object
Factory for creating the appropriate LmClient implementation from LmConfig.

This is the wiring entry point of the LM integration layer. Application code should load LmConfig once (via LmConfig.load(javax.servlet.ServletContext)) and call create(LmConfig) rather than instantiating HttpLmClient or MockLmClient directly.

Selection and fallback rules:

  • null config → MockLmClient with a warning log
  • LmConfig.isEnabled() false → MockLmClient with forceDisabled=true (AI reported as disabled)
  • LmProviderType.MOCK → MockLmClient
  • LmProviderType.OPENAI or LmProviderType.CUSTOM with LmConfig.hasHttpCredentials() → HttpLmClient
  • LmProviderType.OPENAI or LmProviderType.CUSTOM without credentials → MockLmClient with a warning log
